json_schema.title: saltutil.sync_grains
json_schema.description: Sync grains modules from salt://_grains to the minion

saltenv.ui:title: SaltStack environment
saltenv.ui:description: The fileserver environment from which to sync. To sync from more than one environment, pass a comma-separated list.  If not passed, then all environments configured in the :ref:`top files <states-top>` will be checked for grains modules to sync. If no top files are found, then the base environment will be synced (e.g. saltenv=base,dev)

refresh.ui:title: Refresh
refresh.ui:description: If True, refresh the available execution modules and recompile pillar data for the minion. This refresh will be performed even if no new grains modules are synced. Set to False to prevent this refresh

extmod_whitelist.ui:title: Extension modules whitelist
extmod_whitelist.ui:description: Comma-separated list of modules to sync

extmod_blacklist.ui:title: Extension modules blacklist
extmod_blacklist.ui:description: Comma-separated list of modules to blacklist based on type

clean_pillar_cache.ui:title: Clean pillar cache
clean_pillar_cache.ui:description: Set to True to refresh pillar cache
